request.style: English, male solo voice with deep gravel, upright bass, electric guitar, brushed snare, organ, melancholic and soulful mood, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I will not leave you as orphans behind
I am coming to you, the truth defined
In a little while the world will fade
But you will see me in the shade
Because I live, you also will live
This is the gift we must give

[Chorus]
Whoever holds to my commandments
And keeps them with their own life
Is the one who loves me truly
And loves me with the truth
Loved by my Father, I will love him
And show myself to him

[Verse]
On that day you will know it's true
I am in my Father for you
You are in me, I am in you
This is the bond that stands so new
Judas asked why not the world
Jesus spoke the word unfurled
If anyone loves me, keep the word
Make our home with you, my lord

[Chorus]
Whoever holds to my commandments
And keeps them with their own life
Is the one who loves me truly
And loves me with the truth
Loved by my Father, I will love him
And show myself to him

[Bridge]
Whoever does not love me
Does not keep my words to see
The word you hear is not my own
But the Father's who has sown

[Outro]
Show myself to him
Show myself to him
